versions.changelog:
Initial release – generate high-impact nation resilience hook videos with WeryAI models.

- Converts brief prompts into full production scripts with locked subtitle timings (hook, three rapid-fire beats, twist).
- Supports both text-to-video and image-to-video (multi-image for SEEDANCE_2_0 only).
- Exposes model/feature set and prompt boundaries (fixed duration, aspect ratios, audio, negatives per model).
- Automatically assembles required CLI command and confirmation step before video generation.
- Includes strict security and handling guidelines for API keys and image sources.

Initial release of nation-resilience-hook-video-gen.

- Generates vertical video hooks on national resilience using a bold intro, three geography/resources/defense beats, and a twist on risk.
- Includes precise on-screen English subtitles, timed to a specific 10s template (scalable to 5 or 15s).
- Designed for geopolitics Shorts, atlas montage, and country-comparison tension.
- Requires WERYAI_API_KEY, Node.js 18+, and prompt expansion per strict template.
- Exports video using WeryAI backend; supports text- and image-to-video workflows.
- Hardens safety and consent practices, especially with local files and public images.
